glosses: piece, chunk, hunk, bit, bite (a part of a larger whole)
patch (e.g. of sky, cloth, skin, space)

examples.text: Aquí hay un pedazo de papel.

examples.en: I ate three pieces of cake.

examples.text: Me corté con un pedazo de vidrio.
examples.en: I cut myself on a piece of glass.

examples.text: ¿Te importaría escribirlo en este pedazo de papel?
examples.en: Would you mind writing it down on this piece of paper?
